QuestInfo.name: Let's Play Gift... Or Bribe?
QuestInfo.0: Vincent is making sure Vicky's bribe is as bribe-y as possible. Help him just a bit more and you might learn something about the Spirit of Rock...
QuestInfo.1: Vincent says that in order to really convince the judges, Triple Volt will need three different kinds of gifts for each one. Bring Vincent 60 Jr. Pepe Keychains to help him seal the deal.
QuestInfo.2: Vincent wrapped up the Yeti Keychains for the judges, but something tells you that's not going to cut it.

0.0: Yup! And now two to go! They always have three judges for these audition shows. You know: the mean one, the sassy one and the dumb one. We need to get them all on our side!
0.1: I know! We'll get Jr. Pepe Keychains for the next judge.
0.2: I can't wait to see Vicky's expression when she wins! She's gonna be so happy... I mean... I mean I can't wait to see how happy you look when you meet the Spirit of Rock... yes...

no.0: Hey, can't you see the disappointment in my eyes?

1.0: I just know Vicky's gonna win! I can't wait for her to like me!

0.msg: Wow, this Jr. Pepe Keychain... just wow. So fancy. The blue skin, white belly, and look at that muffin top! So pudgy and adorable!

1.msg: It's so cute... Just like me!

2.msg: I dunno... It's not THAT cute...

3.msg: (I don't think this guy has a belly like Pepe.)

item.0: We can't miss this opportunity! The opportunity for me to capture Vicky's heart... er... I mean... I mean for you to meet the Spirit of Rock! Yes... yes, that's what I meant...
